mapper.select: SELECT rs.*, l.seller_sku, s.name AS store_name, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name FROM ecom_replenish_setting rs LEFT JOIN ecom_listing l ON l.id = rs.listing_id LEFT JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = l.store_id LEFT JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = COALESCE(rs.material_id, l.material_id) WHERE rs.id = #{id}
